components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant accountable action in a workflow or civic module.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; color: #fff; background: var(--violet); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 780; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 22px rgb(101 71 245 / .22); transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--violet-deep); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgb(101 71 245 / .28); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.975); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .52; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A useful positive or supporting action with strong presence but lower hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text); background: var(--lime); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 780; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #bce557; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.975); }

components.name: Civic Auth Mosaic
components.description: The mobile-safe auth identity: a semantic scroll action plus the compact living-map module that remains visible after the access panel moves first.
components.html:
Ваш сигнал запускает изменения

●Сигнал принят
components.css: .ds-auth-mosaic { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr; gap: 14px; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-signal, .ds-auth-map { min-height: 260px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-auth-signal { background: var(--lime); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-auth-signal h2 { max-width: 9ch; margin: 0 0 18px; font-size: clamp(30px, 5vw, 48px); line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-auth-signal button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; color: #fff; background: var(--violet); font-weight: 780; cursor: pointer; } .ds-auth-signal button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-auth-map { color: var(--text); background: var(--coral); } .ds-auth-map::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 22px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--cream); transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-auth-river { width: 42%; position: absolute; inset: -15% auto -15% 24%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cyan); transform: rotate(18deg); } .ds-auth-road { height: 14px; position: absolute; left: 9%; right: 7%; top: 43%; border: 4px solid var(--text); border-inline: 0; border-radius: 999px; transform: rotate(-12deg); } .ds-auth-map i { width: 52px; height: 52px; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 34%; border-radius: 17px; color: #fff; background: var(--violet); display: grid; place-items: center; font-style: normal; } .ds-auth-map strong { padding: 8px 11px; position: absolute; left: 36px; bottom: 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); font-size: 12px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-auth-mosaic { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-auth-signal, .ds-auth-map { min-height: 232px; border-radius: 20px; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard search and form field for cream working surfaces.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Адрес<input class="ds-field" placeholder="Улица, дом или ориентир" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { color: var(--text); display: grid; gap: 7px; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field { width: min(100%, 380px); min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; outline: 0; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--violet); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 84%); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .52; }

components.name: Informational Status
components.description: A compact text-first workflow state in the violet family.
components.css: .ds-status-info { min-height: 23px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 8px; color: #4d35bd; background: var(--violet-soft); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 750; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Working Card
components.description: A flat cream evidence or action surface inside the colorful marketplace.
components.html:
Состояние на месте

Фотографии и описание подтверждают текущую ситуацию.
components.css: .ds-working-card { max-width: 380px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; box-shadow: none; } .ds-working-card strong { font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; } .ds-working-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-working-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Responsive Navigation Item
components.description: The active lime desktop destination and its tap-safe fixed resident form.
components.html: Карта
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 6px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; position: relative; z-index: 1; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 620; text-decoration: none; pointer-events: auto; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; color: var(--violet-deep); } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--text); background: var(--lime); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav { min-height: 64px; position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 900; isolation: isolate; pointer-events: auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 54px; justify-content: center; color: var(--violet); font-size: 9px; } }

components.name: Four-Color Summary
components.description: The recurring role-dashboard summary that assigns one functional color to each operational slice.
components.css: .ds-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-summary article { min-height: 112px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 16px; display: grid; align-content: space-between; } .ds-summary span { font-size: 12px; } .ds-summary strong { font-size: 31px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-summary-violet { color: #fff; background: var(--violet); } .ds-summary-lime { color: var(--text); background: var(--lime); } .ds-summary-cyan { color: var(--text); background: var(--cyan); } .ds-summary-coral { color: var(--text); background: var(--coral); } .ds-summary article:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 960px) { .ds-summary { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-summary { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-summary article { min-height: 94px; } }

components.name: Selected Register Row
components.description: The dense city-signal row selected with a lime wash and explicit workflow status.
components.css: .ds-register-row { width: 100%; min-height: 110px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); background: var(--lime-soft); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset -1px 0 var(--lime); transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-register-row > i { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); } .ds-register-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-register-copy > span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-register-copy strong, .ds-register-copy small { color: var(--muted); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-register-copy em { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 8px; color: #4d35bd; background: var(--violet-soft); font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; font-style: normal; font-weight: 750; } .ds-register-copy b { overflow: hidden; font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-register-row:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-register-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Map Context Sheet
components.description: The elevated evidence panel that connects a selected register row to the live 2GIS map.
components.html:
Выбранный сигнал

Адрес, статус и следующий шаг остаются в одном контексте.
components.css: .ds-map-sheet { width: min(410px, calc(100% - 32px)); padding: 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); animation: ds-sheet-enter 220ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-map-sheet strong { font-family: "Onest", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; } .ds-map-sheet p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-map-sheet-handle { display: none; } .ds-map-sheet:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-sheet-enter { from { transform: translateY(12px); opacity: .8; } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-map-sheet { width: 100%; padding-top: 48px; position: relative; transition: transform 240ms var(--ease-drawer); animation: none; } .ds-map-sheet-handle { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; border: 0; background: var(--surface); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-sheet-handle span { width: 36px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--line); } }

narrative.overview:
The shipped system is a fresh civic marketplace: a warm lavender city canvas filled with high-confidence functional modules. Electric violet drives action and identity, lime marks useful progress, coral brings consequence forward, and cyan connects the interface to maps, movement, and verification. The result is bold and public-facing without becoming promotional; every bright block still points to a real civic step.

The system has two speeds. Large colored modules explain, orient, and summarize. Cream working surfaces hold forms, evidence, registers, and role-specific operations with lavender-gray rules and explicit status text. This contrast lets residents scan on the street while operators keep dense queues readable on wide screens. Light and dark themes preserve the same role assignments rather than improvising a second visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Warm lavender canvas and cream working surfaces.
Electric violet, signal lime, attention coral, and map cyan with stable functional roles.
Oversized civic headlines paired with compact operational metadata.
Bold modules for orientation; disciplined rows and tables for work.
Soft lift only on primary actions, composite canvases, and true overlays.

rules.name: The Four-Color Routing Rule
rules.body: Violet acts, lime advances, coral alerts, and cyan maps or verifies; do not swap these roles for novelty.

rules.name: The Status Still Speaks Rule
rules.body: Bright color accelerates scanning, but every status remains named in text or reinforced by a value and icon.

rules.name: The Warm Canvas Rule
rules.body: Cream surfaces sit on lavender; pure white is reserved for high-contrast controls inside saturated modules.

rules.name: The Big Civic Voice Rule
rules.body: Use oversized type for the current civic proposition or workspace purpose, never for routine metadata.

rules.name: The Tabular Evidence Rule
rules.body: Counts, identifiers, dates, deadlines, and changing measures align with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Two-Speed Layout Rule
rules.body: Use large color modules to orient or summarize, then return to cream rows and tables for detailed work.

rules.name: The Topology-Preserving Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts change order and grouping before they shrink essential targets or force horizontal scrolling.

rules.name: The One Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: A surface earns shadow only by acting, floating, or containing a composite product canvas; ordinary working cards stay flat.

dos: Do preserve the four functional color roles across auth, shell, maps, and role workspaces.
Do pair bold summary modules with calmer cream registers and evidence surfaces.
Do keep every status explicit in words, structure, and color together.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible focus, reduced motion, safe areas, and the isolated mobile navigation plane.
Do keep the register useful when 2GIS credentials or map loading are unavailable.
Do stack or recompose dense desktop topology before allowing horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't revive the restrained municipal-blue ledger as the product's visual identity.
Don't use violet, lime, coral, or cyan as interchangeable decoration.
Don't place shadows on every working card or add gradients to the solid modular palette.
Don't let abstract map geometry replace the real interactive 2GIS product map.
Don't invent city metrics, outcomes, or SLA claims to fill a colorful module.
